Design.

Even more delightful.
Even more durable.

Meet the new Coloron Ds K2604 Surveillance Unit. Designed with contoured edges, precision weather-sealed joints, and durable materials like IK10 vandal-proof armor on the front, it looks — and stays — beautiful. You can see and protect more of everything with an expansive F1.0 ultra-aperture lens. And enjoy 24/7 crystal-clear full-color surveillance with Smart Dual Illumination, with intelligent warm LED activation up to 40 meters. Take it for a spin.

IK10 Vandal Armor. Aerospace-grade cast aluminum housing withstands 20-joule mechanical hammer impacts.

Descriptions

Features

  • Starlight
  • 2MP ( 1920 × 1080 ) @30fps
  • Support smart H.265/H.264 coding
  • ICR auto switch, true day/night
  • Up to 100m IR night view distance; motorized zoom lens
  • 3D DNR, true WDR, HLC, BLC and ROI coding
  • Built-in micro SD card slot, up to 256GB
  • 1CH audio input; 1CH audio output
  • 1CH alarm input; 1CH alarm output
  • DC12V/PoE power supply
  • Support three streams
  • IP67
  • Support mobile surveillance by smart phones with iOS and Android OS
  • Intelligent analytics: video abnormality (video blur detection, video cast detection, scene change), license plate recognition
